# Asana Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that works with your Asana: view tasks assigned to you and create new tasks (needs a workspace id — the skill asks if it's unknown). Creating a task needs your confirmation; reading needs none. No secrets in the repo — credentials stay in Muse's secure vault.
